name: @storytree/dev-loop
description: Mick's dev loop (story_95ed402f9bd3, ADR-0805 D3, ADR-1170 D3, ADR-1192 D2): the personal half of the dev loop, around the base dev loop (packages/base-dev-loop), which holds the gate runner, the test runner and its scoping, the worktree installer and the merge-queue scripts: storytree's gate (its lock and worktree install; the repository's own checks contribute their steps from packages/repo-checks, and Mick's factory plugin micks-dev-loop its own and the guidance build), and its `pnpm test` (the base runner holding the heavy-run lock). The root package.json's commands and CI run them from here.
